chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Talhah ibn Zayd, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Indeed, the false oath locks the wombs. He said, 'May I be sacrificed for you, what is the meaning of 'locks the wombs'?' He said, 'It sterilises.'
ai.seo_question: What is the effect of a false oath on fertility according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from al-Kafi, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the metaphysical impact of a false oath (al-yamin al-fajirah) by linking it to physical sterility, defining the term 'tunghilu' as 'tu'qiru' (causing infertility). This reflects the Shia scholarly understanding that spiritual transgressions manifest in bodily conditions, serving as a divine warning against perjury. The narration underscores the tangible consequences of breaking one's word before God, extending beyond mere social dishonesty to affect lineage and fertility.
